title: Scoped MediaStore and playback promotion boundary decision

decision.reason: v1.3 keeps playback, playlists, scanFile, MediaStore query/mutation, broad media-library permissions, and raw media handles denied until a future scoped provider gate supplies exact capabilities, ownership, permission, packaged, privacy, rollback, and raw-object denial evidence.

stableDeniedSurfaces.requiredFutureEvidence: A scoped playback provider must define source ownership, lifecycle handles, audio focus, background behavior, notification or foreground disclosure where needed, packaged stress, and rollback cleanup.
Playlist and queue behavior requires bounded JSON descriptors, owner-scoped handles, lifecycle cleanup, and privacy review before promotion.
Media scanner integration requires scoped paths, package ownership, denial for broad external paths, and device/package evidence.
MediaStore access requires a dedicated scoped provider with exact capabilities, Android permission matrix, owner-scoped rows, privacy review, packaged evidence, and rollback cleanup.
Broad media-library or shared-storage permissions are denied unless a future gate proves necessity, user disclosure, least privilege, and downgrade behavior.

readyEvidence.summary: P14-26 imports playback and MediaStore stable-denial evidence while keeping the media surface read-only.
P15-20 keeps packaged recorder/media stress partial and unpromoted before MediaStore/playback boundary promotion can be decided.
The mediastore_playback provider remains stable_denied until every promotion evidence bar is satisfied by a future scoped provider gate.
The mediastore_playback provider declares denial diagnostics, disclosure, rollback, Safe downgrade, and crash circuit breaker requirements.
P15-21 owns P14-26 under pro.tasks_device_media with boundary_decision_archive evidence.

openBlockers.requiredEvidence: Decision archive for scoped playback provider or continued stable denial, covering exact capabilities, source ownership, lifecycle handles, audio focus, background behavior, packaged evidence, and rollback.
Playlist/queue stable-denial or scoped-provider archive proving bounded descriptors, owner-scoped handles, and cleanup.
MediaStore scoped query/mutation decision archive covering exact capabilities, Android permission matrix, owner-scoped rows, privacy behavior, packaged evidence, and rollback cleanup.
Broad media-library permission denial archive for READ_MEDIA_* and MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, including user disclosure and downgrade behavior if any future exception is proposed.
Packaged APK denial archive proving playback, playlist, scanFile, MediaStore, broad storage, raw handles, and metadata mismatch stay denied without a full provider gate.
Safe downgrade proof that provider disable keeps MediaStore/playback mutations denied, preserves read-only media status, and emits scoped diagnostics.

Security regression coverage proving MediaPlayer, AudioTrack, AudioFocusRequest, ContentResolver, MediaStore cursor, Uri, ParcelFileDescriptor, file descriptors, playlist handles, Context, and Java objects remain denied.
P15-22, P15-23, P15-25, and P15-26 sync before any future playback or MediaStore scoped provider can be marked promoted.
